Southampton attempted to regain control with a flurry of tactical substitutions, introducing Flynn Downes , Samuel Edozie , and Kuryu Matsuki to inject fresh energy into their midfield and attack. However, the visitors remained disciplined and continued to absorb pressure while looking dangerous on the break. Clinical Finish from the Hammers As the clock ticked down, the quality of West Ham’s substitutes proved decisive. Valentín Castellanos , who had come off the bench, extended the lead in the 75th minute with a close-range finish following an assist from Joël Veltman . The Saints pushed forward in a desperate attempt to stay in the competition, with Finn Azaz seeing his long-range effort saved. However, Jarrod Bowen put the result beyond doubt in the 84th minute, slotting home a left-footed shot after a clever pass from Lewis Orford . Despite a late save by Daniel Peretz to deny Manor Solomon , the match ended 1-4, confirming a dominant away victory for the London side.
